groups.classification: real consensus bug in the Rust client's dependency (stateless-validator-reth a134a621 on reth 3d270d93)
groups.detail: The first Prague block runs while the EIP-7002 (or EIP-7251) predeploy has no code. The EIPs make such a block invalid; reth executes the empty system call and accepts it. Upstream stateless-validator-reth (reference_output) and reth's own stateful replay accept it too. evmone rejects ('withdrawal system contract empty'). Not reachable on mainnet, where both predeploys have code, but it is a spec soundness gap. The RV64 guest also completes with success on all 4 (tier 2 FAIL_NEG).
groups.action: report upstream (paradigmxyz/stateless, reth); not fixed here
groups.status_v2: not re-run in v2 (rust client unchanged); v1 result stands

groups.classification: real consensus bug in the Rust client's dependency (reth 3d270d93 / revm 42)
groups.detail: Valid blocks whose withdrawals credit an account that the EIP-7002/7251 request system call then reads. reth's stateful replay gets a different state root (so the generator had no reth witness and used a full parent-state witness), and every stateless-validator-reth build (upstream workspace with its revm git patch, the crates.io host validator, and our lean-profile host) rejects. evmone reproduces the fixture's block hash and request root exactly. Mainnet-reachable in principle (a withdrawal to an address the request contract reads). The RV64 guest (production lean ELF) traps on the same 8 blocks.
groups.status_v2: not re-run in v2 (rust client unchanged); v1 result stands

groups.tests: 94 ported_static fixture files (stEIP1559, stStaticCall, stQuadraticComplexityTest, stRandom*, ...)
groups.detail: Genesis gas limits of 2^52..2^63-1. glue/stwo_client.cpp pre-sizes the account and storage tables from the gas limit (gas_limit/2400 rows); the reserve throws bad_alloc on the host and cannot fit the guest heap. Mainnet gas limits move by at most 1/1024 per block (~60M today). On RV64 the same sizing exhausts the 212 MiB guest heap ('out of memory') already at a 500M gas limit: 82 eip7685 blocks of 'for_*/prague/eip7685_general_purpose_el_requests' (gas limit 500,000,000) fail only on the guest, plus 27 more blocks with gas limits from 1.5e9 up. 500M is ~8x today's mainnet limit, so this is a forward-looking liveness limit, not a current mainnet failure.
groups.action: closed; static_call1_mb1024_calldepth kept as a resource limit
groups.status_v2: fixed (row_reserve from min(gas_used, 60M) with on-demand growth, commit 365f1b165 lineage): every block of the group passes on host and RV64 v3 guest, except stStaticCall/static_call1_mb1024_calldepth block 1 on the guest: ~1024 frames x 1 MB EVM memory, host peak RSS 600 MB > the 212 MiB guest heap, stwo_guest_abort -> IllegalInstruction after 560k instructions (the Rust guest fails it too). Genuine guest resource limit on a synthetic block (gas limit 2^63-1).

groups.detail: A delegation chain called to the 1024 call-depth limit grows the native build past 38 GB RSS (killed at 4 GiB by the runner); the guest exhausts its heap. Valid block; reth and the Rust guest accept it.
groups.status_v2: fixed by the table-sizing fix (the 1e14 gas limit drove a ~4e10-row reserve, not per-frame growth); passes host and RV64 v3 guest

groups.tests: every block that installs an EIP-7702 delegation and later calls the delegated account (eip7702_set_code_tx, eip7623, eip7939 clz_from_set_code)
groups.detail: ziskethone registers the 0xef0100||address designator code only when a block access list exists (Amsterdam). Its own input generator supplies created code; a canonical EIP-8025 witness carries only pre-state code, so Contracts::index_of aborted. The mainnet basket passed because its witnesses (legacy mode) include created codes.
groups.action: fixed: client_evmone/patches/0005-ziskethone-7702-delegation-code.patch (register the designator like CREATE output)
groups.status_v2: still fixed (passes host and RV64 v3 guest)

groups.detail: Post-state trie updates were applied in row order, so a deletion could collapse a branch before an insertion into it and then need a sibling node the canonical witness omits ('state key not in witness'). The full-state-witness control passed.
groups.action: fixed: glue/stwo_client.cpp applies inserts/updates before deletions in the storage and account tries
groups.status_v2: still fixed (passes host and RV64 v3 guest)

groups.tests: for_{prague,osaka}/prague/eip2537_bls_12_381_precompiles: bls12_g2mul (all cases, incl. one_times_inf, call types) and single-pair bls12_g2msm
groups.classification: real RV64 client bug (memory corruption in the G2 scalar-multiplication path), mainnet-reachable
groups.detail: The guest traps with UnmappedAddress in memcpy (copy_forward) with a garbage source pointer (0xd201000000010000) after ~2.5M instructions. The native host build passes every case; it links blst's assembly, while the guest compiles blst portable C (__BLST_NO_ASM__) with patch 0002 (64-bit limbs, __int128). G1 operations, pairings and maps pass on the guest. BLS12-381 precompiles are live on mainnet since Prague: a block calling G2MUL/G2MSM would make this guest fail (liveness, not soundness).
groups.status_v2: fixed (patch 0002: quot_rem_64 calls quot_rem_n with n=1 under __builtin_assume(n%2==0), UB with 64-bit limbs; weakened to n!=0; host test tests/blst_portable.c). All eip2537 blocks pass on the RV64 v3 guest.
